notes.title: Server Stabilization Patch (No Downtime)
notes.content: [p]To ensure a more stable service, server stabilization work will soon be carried out.[/p][p][/p][p]This process does not require scheduled maintenance, but the server list may temporarily not appear.[/p][p]If this happens, please fully exit and restart the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, some ongoing queues may be reset.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely appreciate the incredible interest you've shown in the Chrono Odyssey Closed Beta Test,[/p][p]and we are doing our utmost to provide a stable testing environment.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: [Update] NA Server Experiencing Instability
notes.content: [p]Greetings Sentinels,[/p][p][/p][p]We’d like to share an update regarding the recent server instability affecting the NA region.[/p][p][/p][p]At this time, the NA servers have shown signs of stabilization, and the frequency of related issues has been reduced. However, we are aware that some disruptions may still occur, and our team will continue to closely monitor server activity to ensure improved performance going forward.[/p][p][/p][p]We understand that connectivity issues can be frustrating, especially during an important testing phase, and we deeply appreciate your patience and understanding as we’ve worked through these challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][strike]The [b]NA-03[/b] / [b]NA-42 [/b]/[b] NA-25[/b] servers are currently experiencing instability.[/strike][/p][p][strike]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and are actively working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.[/strike][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and understanding.[/p]

notes.title: Server Expansion and Access Distribution Update (Updated: 6/20 7:30 PDT)
notes.content: [p]Greetings Sentinels,[/p][p][/p][p]To allow more players to join the test, a server expansion work along with additional access will soon take place. [/p][p][/p][p]※ During the preparation phase for the server expansion, queue sessions may be temporarily cleared.[/p][p]※ The server list may not be fully displayed. notes.title: Chrono Odyssey Global Closed Beta Announcement
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the Closed Beta is on the way. 
Available on PC via Steam Playtest, the test will feature early main story quests and three playable classes: Swordsman, Ranger, and Berserker.

More details on the closed beta will be shared in the next notice!
In the meantime, watch our official announcement trailer and get ready to shape the future of Setera.

[previewyoutube=F6qozCE0gKg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Sign Up[/h2]
1. Log in to your Steam Account.
2. Go to the Chrono Odyssey Store Page. 
3. Click the [b]"Request Access"[/b] button to apply.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873440/Chrono_Odyssey/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=steam&utm_campaign=CBT
Don't forget to wishlist the game to stay updated!

Thank you

notes.title: Developer's Notes #1: What we've been up to
notes.content:
We want to express our heartfelt thanks to everyone who has been patiently waiting for our game. We know many of you have been eager to hear new updates, so today, we’d like to share a small part of what’s been going on.

[h3][b]Taking a Step Further[/b][/h3]
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44935330/65e041265d6dcb6ae626506b909f6f0d998a56b8.jpg[/img]
Back in February, we held a private [b]Focus Group Test[/b]. Many players participated and thanks to the amazing feedback and in-depth data, we’ve been able to further move forward with the direction of the game. Since then, we’ve been focusing on refining areas that needed improvement and pushing the overall polish to the next level. 

To give you a small glimpse of what was tested during the FGT, [b]Soroma Stronghold[/b] stood out as one of the most popular areas in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44935330/fa9174818a2ebf2a8ce60a9dcbde03b274b78e95.jpg[/img]
[i]There are rumors of a mysterious presence near Soroma Stronghold. To uncover the truth, someone may need to venture deep into the mist. [/i]

[i]Travelers will naturally come across this region during their journey, but Soroma Stronghold is far from just another exploration site.  It carries a strange, eerie atmosphere, as though something important is hidden within. What could be waiting inside?[/i]

Among all the content in the test, [b]Bounty Hunting[/b] came out as the most popular. Tracking and taking down powerful targets requires not just skill but a little bit of observation and patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44935330/c3daf4c26e753e73736d64b3e2ef3a177e269667.png[/img]

[i]One of the most frequently hunted bounties was [b]Ravenous Bog[/b]. This hulking brute may appear clumsy, but don't let that fool you. As for where you might run into him… we’ll leave that for you to discover when the time comes.[/i]

[h3][b]Coming Soon[/b][/h3]
[hr][/hr]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873440/Chrono_Odyssey/
Even at this very moment, our team is working to build and fine-tune every part of the game to bring you the best possible experience. And very soon, we believe the time will come when we can finally present Chrono Odyssey.

Your continued support and interest have been an incredible source of motivation for us. We’re doing our best to prepare so that we can share this world with everyone.

We’ll be back with even more exciting news next time.


Thank you,
[i]From the Chrono Odyssey Development Team. [/i]
